1057 AM EDT Sat Sep 26 2026

chance of rain.

to 20 kt after midnight. Waves 2 to 3 ft. 
.MON...NW winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 10 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 1 ft or less.

.WED...S winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft or less.
